programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: House of 9
programme.desc: Trapped in a deserted house, nine people must play a deadly game of survival.

programme.title: Black Cop
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect.

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: Living in Fear
programme.desc: A man and wife return to an old town for the reading of his father's will. It soon becomes clear that Chuck's home town is brimming with old enemies, many of whom believe his father (a priest) cheated them out of $250,000 worth of investments.

programme.title: Trigger
programme.desc: Vicki compares the new Peugeot 207 GTi against a classic Peugeot 205 GTi to see if it really does live up to the old car. Jonny road tests the new £350,000, 207mph Mercedes-Benz McLaren SLR Roadster. Tiff and Jason put the Audi R8 and the Porsche 911 Carrera 4S head-to-head. Fifth Gear meets up with Paddy McGuinness once again as he prepares for and takes his motorcycle test. Man looks at what happens when a big, 15 year old Volvo 940 estate crashes into a small, light, 3 year old Renault Modus which has a 5 star Euro NCAP safety rating.

programme.title: Weaponized
programme.desc: A damaged homicide detective (Johnny Messner) must prevent a grieving father from unleashing a "robotic virus" that he believes will destroy the terrorist cell that murdered his son, but at an unimaginable cost.

programme.title: Weaponized
programme.desc: A damaged homicide detective (Johnny Messner) must prevent a grieving father from unleashing a "robotic virus" that he believes will destroy the terrorist cell that murdered his son, but at an unimaginable cost.

programme.title: Supercon
programme.desc: This episode revolved around the fading popularity of local ice cream vans. The subject of the documentary is Mr Softytop, a grumpy ice-cream man who verbally assaults his customers and Darren, his assistant. His attempts to boost sales include inventing the "Millennium Cone", selling at the site of road accidents and renting pornography, films include: Shaving Private Ryan, Beverly Hills Cock, Look Who's Porkin and the Phantom Penis. (A real sex shop in Bolton is called Softy's Hard Stuff). To make matters worse he has to compete with a new competitor, Signór Wippy.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: Action movie. American action, produced in 2017. FBI agent Gretchen Blair receives a strange offer from a fellow passenger regarding an impending hijacking. She soon finds herself trapped in a mid-air heist, fighting to protect everyone on board.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Summer Dreams
programme.desc: Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: That Trip We Took with Dad
programme.desc: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

programme.title: The Groomsmen
programme.desc: A 30-something man decides to marry his pregnant girlfriend and asks his four best friends to stand with him at the wedding, but as he observes his friends relationship troubles, he wrestles with issues of fatherhood, marriage and growing up.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: Set in Paris in 1919, this biopic presents the life of Italian artist Amedeo Modigliani, centering, artistically, on his relationship to and rivalry with Pablo Picasso when they both lived in Paris. Modigliani, an Italian Jews from Livorno, has fallen in love with Jeanne, a young and beautiful French Catholic girl. The couple has a child, and Jeanne's bigoted father sends the baby to a faraway convent to be raised by nuns. Modigliani is distraught but needs money to rescue and raise his child. Paris' annual art competition is in the offing. Prize money and a guaranteed career await the winner.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: Set in Paris in 1919, this biopic presents the life of Italian artist Amedeo Modigliani, centering, artistically, on his relationship to and rivalry with Pablo Picasso when they both lived in Paris. Modigliani, an Italian Jews from Livorno, has fallen in love with Jeanne, a young and beautiful French Catholic girl. The couple has a child, and Jeanne's bigoted father sends the baby to a faraway convent to be raised by nuns. Modigliani is distraught but needs money to rescue and raise his child. Paris' annual art competition is in the offing. Prize money and a guaranteed career await the winner.

programme.title: Karmouz War
programme.desc: General Yousef al-Masri is a well-respected member of the police, living in Karamouz neighbourhood in Alexandria. When a girl raped by British soldiers comes to his station, he is determined to protect her. After he puts the soldier they arrested in custody, hell breaks loose and we witness a one man's fight against an entire army. The story takes place during the reign of King Farouk prior to the 1952 revolution in the English occupation of Egypt.

programme.title: The Ultimate Weapon
programme.desc: When mercenary "Hardball" Cutter discovers that the team he is working with is actually a group of IRA gunrunners, he decides to put a stop to their plans. Furious with Cutter, the gunrunners target him, his partner, and his family.

programme.title: Jungle Boy
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Decembers
programme.desc: Diciembres centres on the US invasion of Panama in 1989 and a reconciliation among survivors a decade later. Ten years after the brief but brutal US military invasion of Panama on December 20th, 1989, three estranged survivors are nudged towards an intimate reconciliation by the person they lost in common that ruthless night.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: The first episode of a medical crime thriller series following a team of investigators as they uncover corruption and negligence. Dr Lucinda Edwards is a smart and experienced A and E doctor in the midst of a nightmare shift - she has a gunshot victim and an opioid overdose patient who both need a bed in resus, but there's only room for one of them. When one of the patients dies, Lucinda realises that her troubles have only just begun as she faces a probe by the Medical Investigation Unit.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: McCinsey's Island
programme.desc: A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Perilous
programme.desc: Handsome young attorney goes to Russia for business trip where he meets young, misterious, beautiful and exotic Russian woman named Sasha.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: Joel Reynolds is the owner and founder of Reynolds Extract, a flavoring-extracts company. Although his business is successful, his marriage lacks passion. He is also often accosted by his annoying neighbor, Nathan. One day, a series of mishaps occur at the extract factory, resulting in an employee, Step, losing a testicle. Cindy, a con artist, reads a news story about the accident. Hatching a get-rich-quick scheme, she gets a temporary job at the factory, manipulating Joel into giving her more information about Step. She also begins a series of petty thefts from her co-workers, who openly accuse each other of the thefts. Although Step initially decides not to sue the company, he changes his mind after a meeting with Cindy, that she sets up in order to meet and flirt with him. Under Cindy's influence, Step hires attorney Joe Adler.

programme.title: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done
programme.desc: The film begins with Detective Havenhurst driving with his partner Detective Vargas. They receive a call and drive to the scene of a murder. As they push their way through the crowd at the crime scene, they see Brad McCullam leaving with a coffee cup. Inside the house, the detectives find the body of Mrs. McCullam, Brad's mother, who has just been stabbed with an antique sword. At the scene are the neighbors and chief witnesses, Mrs. and Miss Roberts. The detectives soon realize that they had just seen the murderer leaving the scene.

programme.title: She's No Angel
programme.desc: A pregnant woman fleeing a violent boyfriend, boards a train and is taken into care by a newlywed couple. The train crashes, the couple are killed and the girl is taken for the dead newlywed wife because she was wearing her ring at the time the crash happened.

programme.title: Bradi elu
programme.desc: USA 2017 draama / komöödia Lavastaja:Mike White Osades:Ben Stiller, Austin Abrams, Jenna Fischer Keskealine Brad Sloan (Ben Stiller) elab koos naise ja pojaga korralikku pereelu, kuid kadestab oma vanu sõpru Craig Fisherit (Michael Sheen), Billy Wearslterit (Jemaine Clement), Jason Hatfieldi (Luke Wilson) ja Nick Pascale'i (Mike White), kes on kõik rikkad ja elus palju saavutanud. Craig töötab Valges Majas ja on avaldanud menuka raamatu, Jason on eduka investeerimisfondi omanik, Billy müüs oma ettevõtte maha, kolis Mauile ja läks varakult erru ning Nick on Hollywoodi lavastaja. End vanade semudega võrdlev Brad hakkab kahtlema valikutes, mis ta elu jooksul on teinud.

programme.title: Sibyl
programme.desc: Psühhoterapeut Sibyl (Virginie Efira) kavatseb loobuda oma põhitööst ja hakata kirjanikuks. Liiatigi pakuvad viimase patsiendi probleemid ohtralt ainest. Kinnisideeks muutuv huvi näitlejahakatise Margot' (Adèle Exarchopoulos) elu vastu tõmbab Sibyli afääridesse, mis seavad ta silmitsi oma minevikuga. Koomiliselt realistlik linalugu tugevatest naistest, kes püstipäi oma koha eest võideldes tahaks vahel lihtsalt alla anda. R: Justine Triet.

programme.title: Sugupoolte heitlus
programme.desc: Lugu tennisetäht Billie Jean Kingist, kes võitleb 70ndatel selle eest, et naistennisistidele makstaks sama palju kui meestennisistidele. Tõestamaks, et naised ei ole ainult kööki mõeldud, peab ta pidama maha tennisemängu 55-aastase pensionil oleva meestennisistiga, kes on avalikult ja uhkelt suur šovinist.

programme.title: Kinsey
programme.desc: Biograafilises draamas kehastab Liam Neeson Alfred Kinseyt, kelle 1948 avaldatud "Mehe seksuaalkäitumist" peetakse esimeseks selleteemaliseks teaduslikuks uurimuseks.

programme.title: Sibyl
programme.desc: Psühhoterapeut Sibyl (Virginie Efira) kavatseb loobuda oma põhitööst ja hakata kirjanikuks. Liiatigi pakuvad viimase patsiendi probleemid ohtralt ainest. Kinnisideeks muutuv huvi näitlejahakatise Margot' (Adèle Exarchopoulos) elu vastu tõmbab Sibyli afääridesse, mis seavad ta silmitsi oma minevikuga. Koomiliselt realistlik linalugu tugevatest naistest, kes püstipäi oma koha eest võideldes tahaks vahel lihtsalt alla anda. R: Justine Triet.

programme.title: Sugupoolte heitlus
programme.desc: Lugu tennisetäht Billie Jean Kingist, kes võitleb 70ndatel selle eest, et naistennisistidele makstaks sama palju kui meestennisistidele. Tõestamaks, et naised ei ole ainult kööki mõeldud, peab ta pidama maha tennisemängu 55-aastase pensionil oleva meestennisistiga, kes on avalikult ja uhkelt suur šovinist.

programme.title: Väike Miss Päikesepaiste
programme.desc: Hullumeelse perekonna ühine teekond Californiasse, kus pere pesamuna osaleb konkursil "Väike Miss Päikesepaiste", on tragikoomiline kannatuste rada, mida saadavad surm, suured muutused ja arusaamine, mida tähendab olla luuser tänapäeva maailmas, kus võitmine näib olevat kõigile kinnisideeks.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: While Ladd's feeding cattle and wild horses, Ree Drummond is getting a jump on the day by making Spicy Stewed Beef, Pimento Cheese and Bacon Grits and a hearty side of Roasted Broccoli Salad with Sour Cream and Parsley Dressing. With dinner in the fridge, she's preparing for a future breakfast with a Mason Jar Pancake Mix perfect for knocking out a great meal any time or if a passing rancher drops by.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.desc: Spike Mendelsohn brings a secret weapon with him to help school Bobby Flay's home team in a burger bash.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson welcome back eight former Christmas Cookie Challenge champions into the workshop to prove who is the best of the best. This time, the cookie makers are facing challenges so merrily massive, they'll be put into teams of two. First, the bakers must weave magic as they create Christmas cookie quilts. One team will have the rug pulled out from underneath them as they're eliminated, while the best quilting team gains an advantage for the next round. Then, the three remaining teams construct gigantic stadiums worthy of the finest North Pole games that also incorporate ingredients perfect for watching a snow bowl: eggnog, hot chocolate, apple cider or mulled wine. The team with the most spectacular stadium will score $10,000 and the right to lift the Best of the Best trophy.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez finds a taste of home as she tries the best Texas barbecue in Los Angeles at Moo's Craft Barbecue. Husband and wife team Andrew and Michelle Muñoz challenge Selena to create a dish that puts her own spin on their meat-centric menu. She decides to create a unique sausage containing the flavors of one her most favorite guilty pleasure foods! Selena and Raquelle quickly find themselves in over their heads as they realize that they have no idea how sausages are made. The stakes get even higher when Nana and Papa show up, two native Texans ready to see if Selena's dish can make the grade and the menu!

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Ranch To Table
programme.desc: Elizabeth celebrates springtime on the ranch by harvesting fresh honey to use in a honey lemon cake. She also puts the honey to use preparing lemon buttermilk fried chicken as a thank you gift for her neighbors.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson are hosting a dramatic opening night in the Christmas cookie playhouse, where four gingerbread masters craft cookie stick puppets. As one puppet master receives a standing ovation and an advantage in the next round, another baker is sent into the wings. The remaining three cookie makers then build grand gingerbread puppet theaters and perform a play for Ree and Eddie! Their massive stick puppet theaters will have to incorporate classic lollipop flavors like orange cream, butterscotch, root beer, cinnamon or espresso. The gingerbreader who receives the biggest applause will win $10,000 and the Golden Ornament.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. programme.desc: It's redemption day in the workshop as hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson welcome back cookie makers who came up just short of winning their first time around. Two cookie makers will experience the ultimate heartbreak, while one will gain an advantage for the second round. The three remaining cookie makers reveal what makes them tick as they construct massive 360-degree Christmas grandfather clocks featuring timely ingredients like instant coffee, instant pudding mix, sloe gin and thyme. The cookie maker who makes the most titanic timepiece will earn redemption and a $10,000 prize.

programme.desc: Dressed as a Christmas tree, host Jesse Palmer kicks things off by asking the final four competitors to honor the holiday tree in the form of a beautifully decorated macaron tower. programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making things easy with four great recipes. First, there's Easy Queso to go with Pork Carnitas that have a shortened cooking time thanks to a multicooker. Then it's over to the slow cooker for Roasted Vegetable Soup to stock the freezer, and Ree's Slow Cooker Irish Oats make an incredible get-ahead breakfast.

programme.desc: Designer Daniel Roseberry spends the day with Ina Garten, sharing fashion secrets and showstopping flower arrangements, after Ina bakes a tri-berry ricotta cake for breakfast. Then, Ina teaches Daniel how to make smashed burgers with caramelised onions.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: The host of a culinary show Delicious Miss Brown was born and raised in Charleston, the heart of all Southern cooking, and her passion for cooking began in her grandmother's kitchen, where she learned to make traditional dishes of the Gullah/Geechee people of which she is a descended. This is the main significant difference from other cooking shows. Chef Kardea Brown keeps all family recipes and traditions carefully and shares them with the viewers, her personality is as irresistible as her food.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: The host of a culinary show Delicious Miss Brown was born and raised in Charleston, the heart of all Southern cooking, and her passion for cooking began in her grandmother's kitchen, where she learned to make traditional dishes of the Gullah/Geechee people of which she is a descended. This is the main significant difference from other cooking shows. Chef Kardea Brown keeps all family recipes and traditions carefully and shares them with the viewers, her personality is as irresistible as her food.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
programme.desc: It's the most competitive time of the year! The Food Network family reunites for more heated holiday throwdowns, with everyone set on taking Bobby Flay down! Familiar faces form their ultimate culinary team to battle Bobby with holiday-inspired dishes.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making things easy with four great recipes. First, there's Easy Queso to go with Pork Carnitas that have a shortened cooking time thanks to a multicooker. Then it's over to the slow cooker for Roasted Vegetable Soup to stock the freezer, and Ree's Slow Cooker Irish Oats make an incredible get-ahead breakfast.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: USA 2009 krimisari Peaosades: Nathan Fillion, Stana Katic, Susan Sullivan, Molly C. QuinnPärast seda, kui sarimõrvar tegutseb tema romaanide süzheede järgi, saab edukas krimikirjanik Richard Castle võimaluse uurimustöö eesmärgil New Yorgi mõrvarühma tööd jälgida. Tal tekib meessoost uurijatega hea klapp, aga naissoost uurijale Kate Beckettile on ta pinnuks silmas. Castle'i omapärane lähenemine kuritegude lahendamisele on mõrvarühmale üllatavalt suureks abiks. Tema ja Becketti suhe muutub veelgi pingelisemaks, kui naisest saab Castle'i uue raamatu peategelase prototüüp. Tihtilugu tekib Richardil probleeme ka oma teismelise tütre ja emaga.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Will Trent
programme.desc: Kui kaks politseinikku saavad vabal ajal haavata, peab GBI juhtumi lahendamiseks üles otsima eriagendi Will Trenti, kes on hiljuti linnast lahkunud. Uurimise käik viib Willi oma minevikku, et puhastada rivaalitsemise ja korruptsiooni keskel oma sõbra nimi.

programme.title: Kondid
programme.desc: Pargist leitakse populaarse telekoka jäänused ning Jeffersoniani meeskond asub juhtlõnga otsima kohalikest restoranidest, mida ta arvustas. Kui asitõendid viivad Royal Diner'isse - Brennani ja Boothi lemmik-söögikohta - tuleb neil seada töötajaid küsitledes ohtu oma staatus restorani patroonidena. Samal ajal müüb Hodgins miljonite eest maha oma uue leiutise ning Brennan loob anatoomiliselt korrektse laulu, et aidata Christine'il õppida erinevate skeletiosade nimetusi.

programme.title: Hädaabi 911
programme.desc: Sari räägib pingelistest kogemustest, millega puutuvad kokku päästetöötajad, kes satuvad ääretult hirmutavatesse, šokeerivatesse ja rabavatesse olukordadesse. Päästjad peavad kuidagi leidma tasakaalu raskes seisus olevate inimeste aitamise ja oma probleemide lahendamise vahel.

programme.desc: Verest tühjaks lastuna leitud naine tõmbab Willi ja Caleb'i kõhedust tekitavasse juhtumisse. Amanda on sunnitud silmitsi seisma oma endiselt painava traumaga.

programme.title: Hädaabi 911
programme.desc: Sari räägib pingelistest kogemustest, millega puutuvad kokku päästetöötajad, kes satuvad ääretult hirmutavatesse, šokeerivatesse ja rabavatesse olukordadesse. Päästjad peavad kuidagi leidma tasakaalu raskes seisus olevate inimeste aitamise ja oma probleemide lahendamise vahel.

programme.title: Kondid
programme.desc: Mõjuvõimas Iraani parlamendiliige röövib Arastoo, et sundida teda lahendama mõrvajuhtumit. Booth ja Cam reisivad Iraani ning ülejäänud meeskond peab ajaga võitlust, et mõrvari isik kindlaks teha. Samal ajal saab Brennan teada Boothi kasvavast hasartmänguharjumusest ning palub Aubrey'lt abi, et kaitsta ennast ja Christine'i Boothi kihlveovahendaja eest.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: USA 2009 krimisari Peaosades: Nathan Fillion, Stana Katic, Susan Sullivan, Molly C. QuinnPärast seda, kui sarimõrvar tegutseb tema romaanide süzheede järgi, saab edukas krimikirjanik Richard Castle võimaluse uurimustöö eesmärgil New Yorgi mõrvarühma tööd jälgida. Tal tekib meessoost uurijatega hea klapp, aga naissoost uurijale Kate Beckettile on ta pinnuks silmas. Castle'i omapärane lähenemine kuritegude lahendamisele on mõrvarühmale üllatavalt suureks abiks. Tema ja Becketti suhe muutub veelgi pingelisemaks, kui naisest saab Castle'i uue raamatu peategelase prototüüp. Tihtilugu tekib Richardil probleeme ka oma teismelise tütre ja emaga.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

Esimene oomen
programme.desc: Noor ameeriklanna saabub 70ndate alguses Rooma, et alustada elu kiriku teenistuses. Seal puutub ta aga kokku maailma ähvardava pimedusega, mis paneb teda kahtlema oma usus. Kahtlused süvenevad veelgi, kui Margaret (Nell Tiger Free) saab teada vandenõust, mille eesmärgiks näib olevat antikristuse sünd. Kriipiv õudusfilm "Esimene oomen" on eellooks 1976. aastal valminud klassikatükile "Oomen".

programme.title: Võimuballaad
programme.desc: Kui Rick, oma hiilgeaegu jau ületanud pulmalaulja, kohtub esinemisel hääbuva poistebändi tähe Dannyga, tekib neil muusika ja hilisõhtuse improviseerimise kaudu side. Kuid kui Danny muudab ühe Riki lauludest hitiks, mis ta karjääri taas käivitab, otsustab Rick tagasi saada tunnustuse, mida ta enda arvates väärib — isegi siis, kui see tähendab riskimist kõigega, mis talle oluline.

programme.title: Tõeline valu
programme.desc: Kahe vastuolulise karakteri, keda mängivad Kieran Culkin ja Jesse Eisenberg, kokkupõrked moodustavad selle südamliku teekonnafilmi selgroo ja ka südame. Kahe Oscari nominent, ühe võitja!

programme.title: Snoopy ja Charlie Brown: Tobukeste film
programme.desc: USA 2015 animakomöödia Lavastaja:Steve Martino Osades(hääled): Charlie võtab ette võimatuna näiva ülesande saada populaarseks ja meeldida seda tehes klassi uuele tüdrukule. Loomulikult ei saa ta seda teha ilma oma leidliku koerata, kellel endal on vaja lüüa õhulahinguid oma vihavaenlase, vilunud õhuässa Punase Paruniga.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: Animaseikluse tele-esilinastus! Elasid kord torifandid, raske põllutööga kurnatud neljajalgsed, kes ei osanud unistadagi paremast elust. Kuni noor torifant nimega Mosley avastas saladuse, et nende esiisad käisid kahel jalal ning nautisid tunduvalt paremat elu kui see, millega tema vanemad ja vanavanemad päevast päeva leppima pidid. Nii asubki Mosley ohtuderikkale teekonnale, et jõuda selle saladuse juurte juurde.

programme.title: Minu naaber Totoro
programme.desc: Satsuki ja tema noorem õde Mei kolivad koos isaga linnast uude maakodusse, et elada lähemal haiglas olevale emale. Peagi avastavad tüdrukud, et vanas majas pesitseb peale nende veel keegi, kes osutuvad kummalisteks, kuid heasoovlikeks vaimudeks. Uudishimulik Mei püüab vaimude elu kohta juurde uurida ja see viib ta maja ääres kasvava suurte puude saluni ning täiskasvanute silmadele nähtamatuks jääva Totoroni, hiiglasliku metsaisandani. Ääretult sõbralik ja rahumeelne metsavaim võtab tüdrukud ruttu omaks ja viib nad vastu ootamatutele seiklustele. Jaapani animelegendi Hayao Miyazaki ("Vaimudest viidud", "Howli liikuv kindlus") neljas täispikk film võitis juba esimesel linastusnädalal nii kriitikute kui ka publiku südamed. Sageli on seda vägivallatut ja helget linateost nimetatud ka maailma parimaks koguperefilmiks, mis iial kinolinale jõudnud.

programme.title: Hotell Transilvaania 2
programme.desc: Drac püüab koos koletistest sõpradega kasvatada lapselapsest tõelist vampiiri, et Mavisel ei oleks põhjust hotellist lahkuda.

programme.title: Ühe liblika lugu
programme.desc: See on südantsoojendav lugu julgest, armsast ja kohmakast ühetiivalisest teismelisest monarhliblikas Patrickust, kes rändab laevaga. Temaga kaasas on naljakas röövik Marty ja terava keelega Jennifer. Patrickust saab järsku kangelane, aga kõigepealt peab ta astuma vastu oma hirmule, võtma omaks ainulaadsuse ja võitma ebaõnne. Samal ajal peab ta võitlema elementidega, vältima kurjust ja näljaseid vareseid, kes ihkavad kättemaksu, ning hoidma ära katastroofi monarhliblikate ohtliku rände ajal.

programme.title: Hotell Translvaania 3
programme.desc: Kõigi lemmikkoletiste perekond läheb luksuslikule koletiste kruiisilaevale puhkama, et Drac saaks pideva hotellikülastajate eest hoolitsemise asemel isegi suve nautida. Dracula kamp lõbutseb laevapardal - mängitakse koletiste võrkpalli, käiakse eksootilistel ekskursioonidel ja päevitatakse kuuvalgel. Kuid unelmate puhkusest saab õudusunenägu, kui Mavis taipab, et Drac on laeva salapärasesse kaptenisse Erickasse armunud. Viimasel on aga ohtlik saladus, mis võib kõik koletised maamunalt pühkida.

programme.title: Jumanji: Tere tulemast džunglisse
programme.desc: Uhiuues seikluses "Jumanji: Tere tulemast džunglisse" astuvad üles ainult staarid – Dwayne Johnson ("Rannavalve", "Kiirete ja vihaste" filmid), Jack Black ("Gulliveri reisid", "King Kong"), Kevin Hart ("Luurespetsid", "Ole tugev!") ja Karen Gillan ("Galaktika valvurid", "Galaktika valvurid Vol.2") - nelja ebatõenäolise sõbra rollis, kes kistakse Jumanji ohtlikusse maailma ja muudetakse ainulaadsete oskustega avatarideks. Neil seisab ees elu ohtlikem seiklus, või siis jäävadki nad igaveseks Jumanjisse...

programme.title: Jumanji: järgmine tase
programme.desc: Filmis "Jumanji: järgmine tase" on jõuk tagasi, kuid mäng on muutunud. Päästmaks üht endi seast, naasevad nad Jumanjisse, kus selgub, et kõik on teisiti. Maailma ohtlikemas mängus ootavad mängijaid ees tundmatud ja avastamata paigad, viljatutest kõrbetest lumiste mägedeni.

programme.title: Arkaadlane
programme.desc: Lähitulevikus on elu Maal hävinud. Paul (Nicolas Cage) elab koos oma teismeliste kaksikutega, Thomas (Jaeden Martell) ja Joseph (Maxwell Jenkins), nende päevad mööduvad rahulikult, kuid ööd on piinarikkad. Päikese loojudes ärkavad metsikud öised olendid, kes aplalt kugistavad alla kõik elusad hinged oma teel. Mehed on isa juhtimisel apokalüptilise maailma reeglitega juba harjunud, kuniks ühel päeval hakkab kõik vasakule kiskuma. Thomas ei jõua õigeks ajaks koju ning tema otsingute käigus saab isa raskelt vigastada. Nüüd jääb ellujäämine kaksikute õlgadele ja kasutusele tuleb võtta kõik teadmised, mida isa on neile õpetanud.

programme.title: Uus algus
programme.desc: USA 2013 romantiline draama Lavastaja: John Carney Osades: Keira Knightley, Mark Ruffalo, Adam Levine Mis juhtub, kui üksikud inimesed kohtuvad ja teevad koos ilusat muusikat?Gretta (Keira Knightley) ja tema kauaaegne kallim Dave (Adam Levine) on keskkoolist saati koos olnud laulukirjutajad, kes kolivad New Yorki, kui mees saab lepingu suure plaadifirmaga. Aga värske kuulsuse ahvatlused viivad Dave'i peagi õigelt teelt kõrvale ning segaduses ja armastuses pettunud Gretta jääb üksi.Tema maailm muutub paremaks, kui põlualune plaadifirma produtsent Dan (Mark Ruffalo) East Village'is tema esinemise peale satub ja on silmapilkselt tema andest lummatud. Sellest juhuslikust kohtumisest võrsub võluv portree neid mõlemaid muutvast koostööst, mille taustaks on suvi New York City's.

programme.title: Näoga mööda asfalti
programme.desc: Mida on üks mees valmis keerulisse olukorda sattudes tegema, et kanda hoolt oma perekonna eest?Selle probleemiga põrkab ühel päeval kokku karmikäeline "vana kooli" politseinik Brett Ridgeman (Mel Gibson), kes ühes oma lühikest süütenööri omava noorema paarimehe Anthony Lurasettiga (Vince Vaughn) on üht järjekordselt kahtlusalust tavapärasest veidi karmimalt kohelnud kui võib-olla viisakas oleks. Võib-olla poleks sellest muidu suurt midagi, üks inimjätis sai avansina paar võmmu, aga see kõik on toimunud uudishimuliku pealtnägija mobiiltelefoni filmimisulatuses ja peatselt on klipp sotsiaalmeedias ning õhtustes uudistes laineid löömas. Lavastaja: S.Craig Zahler Osades:Jennifer Carpenter, Mel Gibson, Vince Vaughn

programme.title: Näoga mööda asfalti
programme.desc: Mida on üks mees valmis keerulisse olukorda sattudes tegema, et kanda hoolt oma perekonna eest?Selle probleemiga põrkab ühel päeval kokku karmikäeline "vana kooli" politseinik Brett Ridgeman (Mel Gibson), kes ühes oma lühikest süütenööri omava noorema paarimehe Anthony Lurasettiga (Vince Vaughn) on üht järjekordselt kahtlusalust tavapärasest veidi karmimalt kohelnud kui võib-olla viisakas oleks. programme.title: Põssa
programme.desc: Omanäoline põnevusdraama erakust trühvliotsijast Robist, kes elab sügaval Oregoni metsades, ainsaks seltsiliseks ta ustav trühvlisiga. Vastumeelselt on mees sunnitud naasma suurlinna ja seisma silmitsi oma minevikuga, kui teda ühel ööl rünnatakse ning tema ainus sõber röövitakse.

programme.title: Tafiti kõrbeseiklus
programme.desc: Aafrika savann on ohte täis, eriti veel surikaadile. Tafiti peaks seda ju teadma. Kui ta pere hämminguks Pinseli-nimelise kohmaka jõesea koju toob, leiab aset tragöödia ja mürgimadu nõelab vanaisa. Tafiti asub ta päästmiseks kõrbeseiklusele, et väidetavalt ravivõimetega legendaarne sinine lill leida. Pinsel järgneb talle otsusekindlalt ja neist kahest saavad ohtlikul teekonnal lahutamatud.

programme.title: Hunt ja lõvi
programme.desc: Muusikakooli õpilane Alma (Molly Kunz) ei osanud oodata, et kui ta pärast vanaisa surma kodumaale naaseb, muutub tema elu täielikult. Ootamatult ilmub kohale vanaisa sõber valge emahunt, kaasas kutsikas, kelle ta jätab elutuppa laua alla, et siis ise kaduda. Samal ajal juhtub läheduses lennuõnnetus ja tüdruk leiab lennuki rusudest imekombel ellu jäänud lõvikutsika. Nii hakkasidki pisikesed koos elama ja Almast sai nende kasuema. Õlgadele langenud vastutuskoorem ähvardab Alma jalust niita, kuid siiski otsustab ta mõlemad loomapojad üles kasvatada.

programme.title: Tintini seiklused: Ükssarve saladus
programme.desc: Reporter Tintin läheb koos kapten Haddockiga aaretejahile laevale, mille komandör oli Haddocki kuangine eellane.

programme.title: Terra Willy: Tundmatu planeet
programme.desc: Mängufilm jutustab loo Willyst, noorest kosmoseuurijast, kes on oma vanematest eraldatud pärast nende laeva hävitamist. Koos oma ellujäämisroboti Bucki ja armastusväärse tulnuka nimega Flashiga peab Willy ellu jääma metsikul, tundmatul planeedil. Koos uurivad nad selle kaardistamata universumi ilu ja ohte, pakkudes avastamisrikka elamuse.

programme.title: Käsilased
programme.desc: USA / Jaapan / Prantsusmaa 2015 animakomöödia EESTI KEELES! Lavastaja: Kyle Balda, Pierre Coffin Osades(hääled):Priit Võigemast Scarleti abikaasana, Tiina Tauraite kuningannana, Märt Avandi Walter Nelsonina, Haide Männamäe Madge Nelsonina, Maiken Schmidt Tina Nelsonina, Priit Pius Professor Fluxina, Tanel Saar Walter Nelson juuniorina, Ain Jürisson Krooni valvurina, jutustaja rollis on Tõnu Mikiver. Käsilased arenesid juba aegade alguses ainuraksetest kollastest organismidest ning nende eesmärk on teisi teenida, ent nad on sattunud järjest mitme edutu isanda teenistusse -türannosaurustest Napoleonini välja. Ilma isandata, keda teenida, langevad käsilased sügavasse masendusse. Ent ühel käsilasel, Kevinil, on plaan. Ta siirdub koos oma semude Stuarti ja Bobiga otsima uut kurja bossi, kellele ta siis koos kaaslastega alluda saaks. Otsingud viivad neid Scarlet Overkillini - maailma esimese naissoost supervargani.

programme.title: Heidi ja väike ilves
programme.desc: Südikas 8-aastane Heidi naudib lopsakate karjamaade ja kõrguvate mäetippude keskel Šveitsi Alpides armastava vanaisaga muretut elu. Kui tüdruk töösturi hr Schnaittingeri lõksu sattunud vigastatud ilvesepoja päästab, paneb ta talle nimeks Pepper ja ravib ta salaja terveks. Kui aga ilvese mänguline trikitamine soovimatut tähelepanu tõmbab, saab Heidi teada Schnaittingeri hävitavast saeveski plaanist, mis seab ohtu mitte üksnes ilvesekutsika, vaid kogu Alpide ökosüsteemi. Heidi asub ustava sõbra Peteri ja truu bernhardiini Josephiga hulljulgele öisele teekonnale, et Pepper tagasi loodusesse pere juurde viia, kuni veel võimalik. Teel saadavad teda looduse ohud, tööstuslik ahnus ja sõprussidemed.

programme.title: Tavalised inglid
programme.desc: Film on inspireeritud uskumatust tõestisündinud loost juuksurist, kes koondab üksi terve kogukonna, et aidata leseks jäänud isal päästa oma raskelt haige väikese tütre elu.

programme.title: Mehed mustas: globaalne oht
programme.desc: Mehed mustas on kanda kinnitanud kogu maailmas, aga sama on teinud ka universumi rämps. Meie kaitsmiseks asuvad koostööle autasudega pärjatud agent H ja sihikindel uustulnuk M - ootamatu paar, kellest võib siiski asja saada. Kui nad seisavad silmitsi uue tulnukaga, kes võib võtta ükskõik kelle kuju, sealhulgas nende agendid, peavad nad ühendama jõud ülemaailmsel seiklusel, et päästa nii agentuur kui ka kogu maailm hävingust.

programme.title: Päev pärast homset
programme.desc: USA 2004 katastrooffilm. Mis siis, kui oleme uue jääaja künnisel? See küsimus vaevab juba ammu kliimateadlast Jack Halli (Dennis Quaid), kelle uurimused näitavad, et lähenemas on ülemaailmne katastroof.Tokyos sajavad maha greibisuurused raheterad, Havaid piitsutavad rekordtugevusega tormid, New Delhis sajab lund ning Los Angelesest käib üle rida tohutu purustusjõuga tornaadosid. Kõne kolleegilt (Ian Holm) kinnitab Jacki kahtlusi: kõik need sündmused on märgid lähenevast muutusest. Globaalne soojenemine on tõuganud maailma uude jääaega ning see saabub läbi ühe suure supertormi. Lisaks Valge Maja hoiatamisele peab Jack jõudma New Yorki, kuhu on lõksu jäänud ta 17-aastane poeg Sam (Jake Gyllenhaal). Aga isegi Jack ei ole valmis selleks, mis ees ootab. Teda, tema poega ja tervet planeeti.

programme.title: Voolusõda
programme.desc: Maailma valgustavate geeniuste lahing filmis "Voolusõda", mis kujutab endast pilguheitu XIX sajandi lõpu suursündmustele. Film jutustab kolme geeniuse, Thomas Edisoni (Benedict Cumberbatch), Nikola Tesla (Nicholas Hoult) ja George Westinghouse (Michael Shannon) intellektuaalsest mõõduvõtust, mis nõudis tohutut vaimujõudu. Elektrienergia tootmise võimaluste pärast algas karm võistlus, mis lõppes alles 2007. aastal.

programme.title: Voolusõda
programme.desc: Maailma valgustavate geeniuste lahing filmis "Voolusõda", mis kujutab endast pilguheitu XIX sajandi lõpu suursündmustele. Film jutustab kolme geeniuse, Thomas Edisoni (Benedict Cumberbatch), Nikola Tesla (Nicholas Hoult) ja George Westinghouse (Michael Shannon) intellektuaalsest mõõduvõtust, mis nõudis tohutut vaimujõudu. Elektrienergia tootmise võimaluste pärast algas karm võistlus, mis lõppes alles 2007. aastal.

programme.title: Kaome siit
programme.desc: Perekonna puhkus kaugele saarele muutub õudusunenäoks, kui nad avastavad, et see saareke on koduks sarimõrvarile.

programme.title: Modigliani kolm päeva hullumeelsuse äärel
programme.desc: Pariis. 1916. Vaataja ees rulluvad lahti 72 palavikulist tundi itaalia kunstniku Amedeo Modigliani (Riccardo Scamarcio) ehk Modi elus. Sõjast laastatud Pariisis põgeneb mees politsei eest. Tema plaani oma karjäär lõpetada ja linnast igaveseks lahkuda laidavad maha boheemlastest sõbrad, prantsuse kunstnik Maurice Utrillo (Bruno Gouery) ja valgeneve juurtega Chaïm Soutine (Ryan McParland) ning Modi inglannast muusa Beatrice Hastings (Antonia Desplat). Mees läheb hoopis nõu küsima kunstikaupmehest sõbra Léopold Zborowski (Stephen Graham) käest. Hallutsinatsioonidest kallutatud eksirännakutele annab aga uue suuna ameeriklasest kollektsionäär Maurice Gangnat (Al Pacino), kelle võimuses oleks muuta Modi elu.

programme.title: Kurepoeg Rihhard 2
programme.desc: Varblane Rihhard on lõplikult valmis, saamaks teejuhiks! Ta teab täpselt, kuidas talvitunud kureparvele üle Aafrika liivakõrbe, tohutute ookeanide ja ohtlike väinade koduteed näidata. Jääb üle vaid eksam sooritada – praktikandi test, et saada kureparve juhiks. See ei tohiks olla keeruline, sest Rihhard on eriline varblane, kes kasvas üles kurgedega ja on juba ammu omandanud kõik lendamise peensused. Sellest pole midagi, et ta on väike – ta on hingelt tõeline kurg!

programme.title: Robotid
programme.desc: USA 2005 animafilmLavastaja: Chris WedgeOsades (hääled): Taavi Teplenkov, Mait Malmsten, Harriet Toompere, Tiit SukkRodney Copperbottom on noor ja andekas leiutajarobot, kes tahab elult midagi enamat kui aastatepikkune nüristav töö kõrvuti oma nõudepesumasinast isaga. Selleks rändab ta Robotlinna, et otsida üles legendaarne leidur Bigweld, kellega koos ta loodab suuri tegusid korda saata. Kohale jõudes kohtub ta kõrgel positsioonil töötava võluva kontoriroboti Cappy ning veidrik Fenderiga, kellel on erakordne anne kõikvõimalikesse sekeldustesse sattuda ja kohati ka sõna otseses mõttes pea kaotada. Avastades, et elu Robotlinnas ei kulge sugugi nii õlitatult, kui ta endale seni ette kujutas, asub Rodney tegutsema, et olukorda muuta.

programme.title: Mina olen Rose
programme.desc: Legendaarne tänavamoeikoon Rozyte on pealinna tänavatel seigelnud juba mitukümmend aastat, rõõmustades möödujaid ja turiste. Suvi asendub sügisega, talv kevadega. Rozyte ei ilmu enam Vilniuse tänavatele. Tema üksilduspäevad teeb helgemaks fotograaf Neringa ilmumine.

programme.title: Mehed mustas: globaalne oht
programme.desc: Mehed mustas on kanda kinnitanud kogu maailmas, aga sama on teinud ka universumi rämps. Meie kaitsmiseks asuvad koostööle autasudega pärjatud agent H ja sihikindel uustulnuk M - ootamatu paar, kellest võib siiski asja saada. Kui nad seisavad silmitsi uue tulnukaga, kes võib võtta ükskõik kelle kuju, sealhulgas nende agendid, peavad nad ühendama jõud ülemaailmsel seiklusel, et päästa nii agentuur kui ka kogu maailm hävingust.

programme.title: Marsupilami
programme.desc: Loomaia töötaja satub pöörasesse seiklusse, kui haruldane olend pääseb vabadusse ja paiskab tema pere kaose keerisesse.

programme.title: Tondipüüdjad: jäine suvi
programme.desc: Spengleri pere naaseb filmis "Tondipüüdjad: jäine suvi" New Yorgi tuletõrjedepoosse, kus kõik alguse sai, et tegutseda koos algsete tondipüüdjatega, kes on ülisalajases uurimislaboris tontide püüdmise uuele tasemele viinud. Kui iidse artefakti avastamisel pääseb valla kuri vägi, peavad uued ja vanad tondipüüdjad jõud ühendama, et kaitsta oma kodu ja päästa maailma uue jääaja eest.

programme.title: Garfield
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsat esmaspäevi vihkavat ja lasanjet armastavat toakassi Garfieldi ootab ees pöörane õueseiklus. Kui Garfield satub ootamatult kokku oma ammu kadunud isaga, tänavakassi Viciga, siis tuleb temal ja ta koerast sõbral Odiel täiuslik poputamist täis elu selja taha jätta ja aidata Vicil ülinaljakat ning kõrgete panustega röövi toime panna.

programme.title: Jääaeg: Kokkupõrge
programme.desc: USA 2016 animakomöödia Lavastaja: Mike Thurmeier ,Galen T. Chu OSades: Anu Lamp, Lembit Ulfsak, Marko Matvere, Priit Võigemast ja paljud teised. Scrati (Chris Wedge) pidevad katsed oma tammetõru kätte saada viivad selleni, et ta vallandab sündmuste laine, mille tõttu asteroidid Maa suunas tormavad. Kaos sunnib Mannyt (Ray Romano), Diegot (Denis Leary), Sidi (Ray Romano) ja nende peresid varjupaika otsima. Seiklushimuline nirk Buck (Simon Pegg) hoiatab neid, et tulemas võib olla massiline väljasuremine. Uut kodu otsides kohtuvad nad mitmete uute tegelastega ja külastavad eksootilisi paiku. Scrati lõputu jaht tabamatule tammetõrule katapulteerib ta universumisse, kus ta lükkab kogemata liikvele kosmilise sündmustejada, mis muudavad ja ähvardavad tervet Jääaja maailma. Selleks, et end päästa, lahkuvad Sid, Manny, Diego, ja ülejäänud kari oma kodust ja asuvad teekonnale täis nalja ja seiklusi, rännates uutele eksootilistele maadele ning kohates tervet hulka värvikaid tegelaskujusid.

programme.title: Harold ja võlukriit
programme.desc: Kui seiklushimuline Harold midagi oma raamatus joonistab, siis see muutub ka tõeliseks. Kui ta aga suureks kasvab ja ennast oma raamatu lehekülgedelt päris maailma joonistab, siis mõistab Harold, et tal on päris elust paljugi õppida ning ta lilla võlukriit võib põhjustada palju sekeldusi. Kui aga piiritu kujutlusvõime vägi valedesse kätesse satub, on vaja kogu Haroldi ja ta sõprade loomingulisust, et päästa nii päris kui ka tema maailm.

programme.title: Tolmukoll
programme.desc: Fantastiline ja riukalikult leidlik "Tolmukoll" on esimene visionäärist filmilooja Bryan Fulleri lavastatud mängufilm, milles 10-aastane tüdruk ühendab oma palgamõrtsukast naabriga jõud, et teineteise koletistega silmitsi seista. Kümneaastase Aurora salapärane naaber (Mads Mikkelsen) tapab päris koletisi, sest ta on palgamõrvar. Aurora soovib tema teenuseid kasutada, et tappa koletis, kes usutavasti kogu ta perekonna ära sõi. Naaber kahtlustab, et Aurora vanemad langesid teda jahtivate mõrtsukate ohvriks ning võtab süütundest tööotsa vastu. Tüdrukut kaitstes tuleb tal mõrtsukatega lahing maha pidada ja tunnistada, et mõned koletised on päris.

programme.title: Aardekütid
programme.desc: Kui tohutu päikesepurse hävitab Maa idapoolkera, palgatakse vapper aardekütt Euroopast ihaldatud "Mona Lisat" otsima. Ta avastab aga seikluse käigus, et maailm vajab maalist enam hoopis kangelast. Peaosades Dave Bautista, Olga Kurylenko ja Samuel L. Jackson.

programme.title: Krahv Monte-Cristo
programme.desc: Noor ja pahaaimamatu Edmond Dantes (Pierre Niney) kistakse kuritegelikku vandenõusse ning lavastatakse süüdi roimas, mida ta sooritanud ei ole. Ta arreteeritakse päeval, mil ta pidi abielluma oma elu armastusega ning visatakse ilma kohtuprotsessita vangikongi. Kurikuulsal Château d'Ifi vanglasaarel vireledes sõbruneb ta oma kaasvangi abee Fariaga, kes avaldab talle seninägematu varanduse asukoha. Lõpuks – olles vanglas veetnud 14 pikka aastat – läheb tal korda põgeneda. Enamgi veel, tal läheb korda rajada tee varanduseni, millest Faria talle rääkis. Nüüd, mil ta on rikkam, kui ta on eales unistanud, saab temast salapärane krahv Monte-Cristo. Ta tõuseb mängleva kergusega Pariisi kõrgkihi hulka, kuid seda ainult ühel eesmärgil – maksta kätte inimestele, kes tema elu hävitasid...

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Besiktas - Paris
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga. Werder Bremen - Hamburg
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Valencia - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Barnwood Builders

programme.title: Homes Gone Wild
programme.desc: Jack McBrayer hunts for wildness in sunny Florida and starts with a maritime-themed property with its own shark! Next, he heads to an estate honoring military flight and sees a storybook-shaped home. Which will be the wildest in the Sunshine State?

programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
programme.desc: The four remaining designers split into two teams to transform the attic into both a spooky speakeasy and a gothic game room. But first, a spine-tingling game brings haunted surprises, pushing their nerves and up-cycled feature projects to the limit.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Based on FBI files on Hitler's health it is determined that the Fuhrer could not have made the long journey from Spain to South America in one nonstop trip. They decide the Canary Islands as the most logical stopping place. Lenny DePaul and Gerrard Williams uncover a documented Nazi presence on the island of as well as an enormous underground naval and U-boat base connected to the Nazi military, previously unknown to the public. Guided by the FBI files and an OSS most wanted list of Nazis, the team concludes that it was possible for Hitler to seek rest and refuge on the island on his way to where the team has determined a U-boat carrying Hitler could have arrived.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Wondrous wizards... Mysterious sorcerers... And heavenly beings... possessed of unimaginable power. Throughout the ancient world, magic was used for everything from healing to communicating with the gods. But did magic really exist in the ancient times? Not as a form of theater - but as a means of replicating the power of the gods? Do ancient accounts of magic suggest evidence of advanced, otherworldly knowledge? A knowledge given to early humans as a means of helping them unlock their own - some might say "divine" - potential?

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. Join host Peter Weller, an actor and a professor at Syracuse University as he travels the world to show the engineering feats that gave rise to some of the greatest civilizations known to man. From Rome to the Pharaohs' Egypt, from Greece to Carthage, from the Aztecs to the Maya and more, this new program from the History Channel uses computer graphics to explore the architectural, political and cultural glory of the world's greatest empires.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Although supernovas are associated with the death of stars they also seed the universe with heavy elements that comprise rocky planets like Earth and living creatures. Due to their extraordinary brightness supernovas have a recorded history dating back 2,000 years. Although closely studied for decades their infrequency has permitted only a general understanding of their behavior until very recently. New computer models can model the major details of the explosion while new exploratory techniques reveal many more events including some truly super supernovas.
